dct_description_sm: Shows buildings built in and previous to 1857. Shows Hennepin Avenue bridge; Mississippi River dam; and Falls of St. Anthony.

River depths shown by isolines.; Includes 1857 building, population, and economic statistics for Minneapolis.; "Original map lithographed by Louis Buechner, St. Paul."; "Designed & drawn by Orlando Talcott, Engineer-Surveyor & Land Agent."; "City Engineer's Office, F.T. Paul, City Engineer. Minneapolis, Minnesota."; "W.P.A. 465-71-3-345."; "Reproduced by D. Greene."
